chapter: Apollo years, Eubie Blake and failing eyesight
title: Duke's pencil and trust between them
summary: Whaley describes Duke erasing and changing notes on scores, and says they trusted each other completely.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: If you can just think of some kind of little anecdotes or some of your old associations with Duke, I'm sure people would like to know because you all were so close. You told me before that Duke always carried a pencil with him and he would go around and mark different things. Can you tell me something about that.
I never knew anything about that. But I know Duke would make an arrangement and he'd have this pencil with an eraser on it and he'd stand up there and erasing
and changing the note. I would say don't be changing no note now, it's on the paper, so then I'd have to change it.
Yeah, orchestration. But you know, it's just like we were -- knew each other, that's all.
You trusted each other, he loved you and trusted you, right.
Yeah, he gave me the thing and I'd go on home and arrange it, see.
